reason: The submitted CIF is valid and explicit: it parses as ordered Cm (No. 8), expands to 8 fully occupied atoms with composition V2S2O2F2 and Z=2 in the stated 207.582 A^3 conventional cell, and primitive-standardizes to one VSOF formula unit (4 atoms, 103.791 A^3). Indexing is exceptionally strong (25/25 principal lines, M(20)=626.8, approximately 0.0012 degree position RMS), and the trace also accounts for weak reflections through 90 degrees with the centering condition and no important unexplained line. Atomic-coordinate evidence is sufficient: the instantiated Cm coordinates fit 41 measured line intensities through 69.8 degrees with residual 0.0170 from inversion-equivalent converged solutions; an independent all-point profile check gives about 4.95% unweighted profile residual versus a 4.77% free-intensity lower bound (profile correlation 0.99875), and local coordinate re-refinement changes no fractional coordinate by more than 0.010 with negligible improvement. The O/F-swapped refinement is quantitatively worse (0.0548), and the submitted ordering is uniquely best among all fixed-site element permutations. Periodic geometry has no overlap (minimum 1.882 A) and gives a coherent V-S/V-F/two-bridging-V-O chain topology with full occupancy and charge-balanced stoichiometry. The lower-symmetry/general-position searches in the trace fit worse or fail chemistry, while no concrete surviving superstructure, ordering, or distinct framework is supported. Another attempt is therefore unlikely to add a materially different viable realization.
